## About
Efficiency Heating & Cooling is a family owned and operated HVAC contractor on Gilbert Road. We work only on heating and cooling, not carpet cleaning or plumbing, so our crews stay focused on your system and the air in your home.
Our certified technicians are paid hourly, not on commission, and we charge by the job instead of by the hour. You know what you'll pay before we start. Regular service calls run on weekdays, and emergency technicians are on call when the AC quits in the middle of summer.
We serve homes and businesses in Gilbert, Chandler, Scottsdale, Ahwatukee, Sun Lakes, Fountain Hills, Paradise Valley, Cave Creek and Carefree. Customers rate us 4.9 from 557 Google reviews.

## Services
- AC and heating repair: Tune-ups, heating repair and standard service calls to keep your home comfortable.
- New system installation: We look at your current setup and install the right unit for your home's square footage and cooling needs.
- Duct cleaning: We only do HVAC work, so when we clean your ducts, that's all we're focused on.
- Indoor air quality: We can help you decide which products would make the air in your home better for your family.
- Energy Savings Agreement: A maintenance plan that keeps your AC tuned up for better efficiency, fewer repairs and longer equipment life.
- Commercial: We handle residential and commercial work, from simple tenant improvements to ground-up buildings.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on Carrier equipment?
A: No. We sell Carrier, but we service and repair every brand of cooling equipment.

Q: What if my AC breaks down at night or on a weekend?
A: Call us. Emergency service is available around the clock.

Q: How often should I have my ducts cleaned?
A: Every 2 to 5 years, depending on how you use your home. Homes with heavy smokers or pets should have ductwork cleaned more often.

Q: Do you offer financing on a new system?
A: Yes, financing is available with approved credit.
